title: Hinomori Shiho — The Right Path For Me〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This street's just live houses left and right.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
And all these people...
They're carrying instruments, so does that mean they play in bands?

rows.Speaker: Street Band Member A
rows.Line: Hey, that girl...

rows.Speaker: Street Band Member B
rows.Line: Yeah, I think it's her...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Are they all staring at me...?
Is it because I'm new here...?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Hang on... This is just like... Hm?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Huh?! This is our live house...?!
What's it doing here?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, is the place next to it one of those venues where only invited bands can perform...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I remember going there a lot during junior high because I wanted to play there someday...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And that venue looks like the legendary live house that the manager used to go to all the time until just a few years ago...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh wow... Up ahead are all the famous live houses that I want to play at, even just once if possible...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Seriously, what is this place...?

rows.Speaker: Girl Band Member A
rows.Line: Hey, isn't that her? Shiho Hinomori...?

rows.Speaker: Girl Band Member B
rows.Line: Yeah, I think she's here for work.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(It's still happening...
What in the world's going on...?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Can I help you...?

rows.Speaker: Girl Band Member A
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry.
It's nothing big...

rows.Speaker: Girl Band Member B
rows.Line: But you were invited by Iori to join STANDOUT, right...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, why do you know about...?

rows.Speaker: Girl Band Member B
rows.Line: Everyone's been talking about how Iori's looking for a new bassist.

rows.Speaker: Girl Band Member A
rows.Line: And all these bassists have started walking on eggshells since joining STANDOUT means getting to debut with a major label...

rows.Speaker: Girl Band Member B
rows.Line:
Yeah.
But you ended up refusing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I did. I already had some bandmates that I wanted to stick with...

rows.Speaker: Girl Band Member B
rows.Line:
That's what we don't get.
I mean, you're so much better than those other girls.

rows.Speaker: Girl Band Member A
rows.Line: Oh, you might not like hearing this, but a lot of people are saying how your talents are going to waste...

rows.Speaker: Girl Band Member B
rows.Line: That includes everyone from the bands you've helped out in the past. They're having trouble wrapping their heads around what you did.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: They are?

rows.Speaker: Girl Band Member B
rows.Line: We're talking about debuting with a major label. Aren't friends normally supposed to give you a big send-off and wish you good luck?

rows.Speaker: Girl Band Member B
rows.Line: Iori saw that you have the skills and willingness to commit, yet you still chose to sit at the kids' table with that band of yours.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Girl Band Member A
rows.Line: Wh-Whoa!

rows.Speaker: Girl Band Member A
rows.Line: S-Sorry about that... Um... Do those other girls not dream of going pro like you?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, they are...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Truth be told, they sort of weren't until just recently. However...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We're nowhere near as good as STANDOUT right now, but someday, maybe we can reach that level, together...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm still not sure what it means to commit to trying to become a pro...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I know that I want to be in a band with you, Shiho. I want to perform in shows with you. I want others to be moved by our music...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If that means aiming to become professionals, so be it...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I don't want you to bear that burden...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Burden? No, don't say that!
We just...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (They showed me that they're serious, and I accepted their commitment.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (So, now...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: My friends are committed to trying to go pro.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We're all going after the same dream, so there was no reason for me to leave our band. That's all.

rows.Speaker: Girl Band Member A
rows.Line:
Right...
I'm sorry. We didn't mean to pry. Anyway, if you'll excuse us...

rows.Speaker: Girl Band Member B
rows.Line: Yeah, now you can tell everyone that you couldn't go pro because you decided to stick with your friends' amateur-hour band.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
What...?!
Hey...!

rows.Speaker: Girl Band Member A
rows.Line: Yeah, what are you doing?!

rows.Speaker: Girl Band Member A
rows.Line:
I'm so sorry, Hinomori!
She's a huge fan of Iori from STANDOUT and this is just her way of showing how much she envies you.

rows.Speaker: Girl Band Member A
rows.Line: So, apologize to her!

rows.Speaker: Girl Band Member B
rows.Line: I'm sorry...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's fine...

rows.Speaker: Girl Band Member A
rows.Line: Again, I apologize for you having to hear all these awful things... Anyway, we should get going.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I thought this situation felt familiar... Other people looked at me the same way after I turned down Iori's offer...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Fortunately, I didn't have to directly deal with any of them, but they're probably all thinking the same thing...)

rows.Speaker: Girl Band Member B
rows.Line: We're talking about debuting with a major label. Aren't friends normally supposed to give you a big send-off and wish you good luck?

rows.Speaker: Girl Band Member B
rows.Line: Iori saw that you have the skills and willingness to commit, yet you still chose to sit at the kids' table with that band of yours.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: They don't know what they're talking about...! And they think it's okay to make fun of Ichika and the others...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (They did something a lot harder than giving me a nice send-off. They committed themselves to our band.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I'd essentially given up on the idea of going pro with them, but they didn't...!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (No one can understand just how much...!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, this is...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (The start of the second verse sounds spotty... There, it happened again...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This synth... Saki?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Are they both here?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's this way...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I wanna play...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I wanna play alongside them...!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (That's what I've always wanted...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I want us to keep playing as Leo/need. I want to keep playing music with them.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I want us to write songs that can move people's hearts!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (That day...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Burden? No, don't say that!
We just...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (They made my wish come true...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (That's why I made the decision I did that day.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I don't care how much longer it takes us. I don't care how much harder it's going to be. If I'm gonna go pro, it's gonna be with Leo/need.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I believe we can do anything as long as we're together. And we're gonna find out what we're really made of!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I ended up back at that fork in the road...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh... I kicked down the “Right” sign by accident... This really isn't in a great spot...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Wait, how was that the “correct” path?
It turned out to be pretty awful.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
But the others...
I can hear them playing somewhere down the left path...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: For a signpost, you're not very good at telling people which way they should go.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, it's this way...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Because the right path for me is the one that involves being with them.)
bgm_area00001
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? Is this the rooftop from SEKAI...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I guess I'm back...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Thank goodness...
We were worried since you were showing no signs of coming back.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Luka, KAITO...
I can't explain what just happened...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: A fragment of a feeling and a different SEKAI...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. You may've been pulled into that SEKAI due to your feelings resonating with someone else's.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: My feeling resonating with someone else's...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, you seemed to have a lot on your mind when we initially walked into this classroom.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Did you find the answer to whatever was on your mind?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I think so...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Our commitment and what we're really made of...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I don't know how things are gonna play out from here. But...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I believe we'll be okay as long as we're together...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: In that case, I'm glad.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Me too...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, speaking of which...
The others should be arriving shortly.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What?! I didn't get to practice at all...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But I get to play with them, so I guess it's okay.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Anyway, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, let's!
